title: Role Preview
summary: Shows what a chosen role can and can't do, the diff from the current role, and a smaller role when the pick adds risky permissions.
description: Role picker that shows exactly what the chosen role can and can't do, diffs it against the current role, and suggests the smallest role that keeps the needed abilities when the pick adds dangerous permissions.
catches: Permissions gained and lost versus the current role
Dangerous capabilities (cost money, destroy data, widen access) marked
A smaller role that drops the dangerous extras, with one-tap switch
limits: Only as accurate as the role matrix you pass
Suggestion is mechanical least-privilege; it doesn't know what the person actually needs
a11y: Role select has a visible label
Diff list has an aria-label and renders in a polite live region
Can/Cannot prefixes and "Can no longer" are text, not colour alone; icons are aria-hidden
server: Authorize role changes on the server and check permissions per request; this only previews the role.
stops: Gave a teammate admin by mistake
